description: Describe the SMQL query language. Without category: the syntax, the has: existence checks and the filter names in each category (Core, Network, WHOIS, Security, Content, TLS, JARM, Technology, JavaScript, Hashes, Files, Hosts, WebAssembly, Deobfuscation, Tracking, Contacts, DNS, CT). With category: every filter in it with its type, description, examples and whether it supports wildcards, ranges or comparisons.

category.description: Filter category to describe in full, for example DNS, Hashes or JavaScript; omit for an index of every filter name.
